shipperDashboard.noOrdersBody: [pt] Once your products go live, buyer orders will show up here for you to confirm and ship.
shipperDashboard.errorGeneric: [pt] Could not load your dashboard data. These endpoints are next in line to build.

buyerDashboard.subtitle: [pt] Your past and current orders.

agencyDashboard.title: [pt] Welcome back, {{name}}
agencyDashboard.subtitle: [pt] Managing agency logistics and active vehicle tracking.

adminDashboard.title: [pt] Admin overview
adminDashboard.subtitle: [pt] Assign trucks, verify drivers, keep the network moving.
adminDashboard.nothingWaitingBody: [pt] Shipment requests needing a driver assignment will queue up here.
adminDashboard.noDriversWaitingBody: [pt] New driver document submissions will show up here for approval.

availableTrucks.title: [pt] Available Trucks
availableTrucks.subtitle: [pt] Your fleet — vehicles registered under your agency.
availableTrucks.noLocations: [pt] None of your trucks have a location set yet — use "Set truck locations" above to place them on the map.
availableTrucks.locationsCount_one: [pt] {{count}} of {{total}} truck have a set location.
availableTrucks.locationsCount_other: [pt] {{count}} of {{total}} trucks have a set location.
availableTrucks.errorGeneric: [pt] Could not load your fleet right now.
availableTrucks.errorAdd: [pt] Could not add truck right now.
availableTrucks.errorUpdate: [pt] Could not update that truck right now.
availableTrucks.errorRemove: [pt] Could not remove that truck right now.
availableTrucks.noTrucksBody: [pt] Register a vehicle to your fleet so it can be matched to shipments.

driverSettings.title: [pt] Driver Settings
driverSettings.subtitle: [pt] Control your duty status, custom map navigation units, and road alerts.
driverSettings.activeDutyDesc: [pt] Toggle on to appear online and accept backhaul cargo matches.
driverSettings.audioAlertsDesc: [pt] Play a loud ringtone whenever a high-match route is offered.
driverSettings.autoNavigateDesc: [pt] Instantly pull up maps right after accepting a cargo load.
driverSettings.gpsSyncDesc: [pt] Allow dispatchers and buyers to track your truck location during a job.
driverSettings.nightModeDesc: [pt] Switch to a dark-charcoal UI to prevent eye fatigue while driving at night.

driverLoads.title: [pt] Available loads
driverLoads.subtitle: [pt] Loads assigned to you, awaiting response or in progress.
driverLoads.notVisible: [pt] You’re not accepting loads right now
driverLoads.nothingWaitingBody: [pt] When admin assigns you a load, it'll show up here for you to accept or reject.
driverLoads.noActiveLoadsBody: [pt] Loads you've accepted will show up here until they're delivered.

shipperSettings.title: [pt] Shipper Settings
shipperSettings.subtitle: [pt] Control your system preferences, API integrations, and display adjustments.
shipperSettings.milestoneAlertsDesc: [pt] Send real-time alerts whenever custom checks, pickups, or deliveries happen.
shipperSettings.erpSyncDesc: [pt] Restrict third-party software from fetching invoice and tracking data logs.
shipperSettings.darkModeDesc: [pt] Switch between standard light screen and cozy dark-room dashboard mode.

adminSettings.title: [pt] Admin Settings
adminSettings.subtitle: [pt] Control platform-wide configuration, moderation rules, and access policies.
adminSettings.newRegistrationsDesc: [pt] Allow new buyers, shippers, drivers, and agencies to sign up.
adminSettings.autoVerifyDriversDesc: [pt] Skip manual document review for drivers who were previously approved.
adminSettings.maintenanceModeDesc: [pt] Show a maintenance banner and pause new shipment/order matching platform-wide.
adminSettings.autoEscalateDesc: [pt] Flag complaints left open for more than 48 hours for priority review.
adminSettings.requireDocReviewDesc: [pt] Block a vehicle from accepting shipments until its documents are admin-verified.
adminSettings.twoFactorDesc: [pt] Require a secondary sign-in step for all admin accounts.
adminSettings.darkModeDesc: [pt] Switch between bright daylight screen and dark-charcoal mode.
